inputs.commit_message: chore: verify local p2p-link updater runtime state
inputs.shell_command: set -euo pipefail; cd /home/hesham/p2p-link; echo '=== FINAL P2P R2 CHECK ==='; echo '--- __main__.py ---'; nl -ba p2p_link/__main__.py | head -220; echo '--- grep timing/update across actual source ---'; grep -RniE '(3600|hour|sleep|publish_registry|put_object|updated_at|headless|start\(|Engine|PeerEngine)' p2p_link scripts docs --exclude='*.pyc' 2>/dev/null | sed -E '/(PASSWORD|TOKEN|SECRET|ACCESS_KEY|AUTHORIZATION|CREDENTIAL)/I s#^.*$#[sensitive-looking line suppressed]#' | head -300 || true; echo '--- external R2 env state ---'; ENVF=/home/hesham/.config/p2p-link/r2.env; if [ -f "$ENVF" ]; then echo 'exists=yes'; stat -c 'mode=%a owner=%U group=%G size=%s' "$ENVF"; sed -n -E 's/^[[:space:]]*(export[[:space:]]+)?([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)=.*/name=\2/p' "$ENVF" | sort -u; else echo 'exists=no'; fi; echo '--- service exact state ---'; systemctl --user status p2p-link.service --no-pager 2>&1 | sed -E '/(PASSWORD|TOKEN|SECRET|ACCESS_KEY|AUTHORIZATION|CREDENTIAL)/I s#^.*$#[sensitive-looking line suppressed]#' | head -120 || true; systemctl --user is-enabled p2p-link.service 2>&1 || true; systemctl --user is-active p2p-link.service 2>&1 || true; echo '--- installed launcher/autostart exact files ---'; for f in /home/hesham/.config/autostart/com.hesham.p2plink.desktop /home/hesham/.local/share/applications/com.hesham.p2plink.desktop /home/hesham/Desktop/com.hesham.p2plink.desktop /home/hesham/.config/systemd/user/p2p-link.service; do if [ -e "$f" ]; then echo "exists $f"; else echo "missing $f"; fi; done; echo '=== END FINAL CHECK ==='
